scope: Complete none/Laya/BGE document retrieval grid on one frozen collection; no generated-answer accuracy evaluation.

coverage.gemma_full_grid_status: unsupported: no configured adapter in this run; separate 5-query smoke is not full coverage

statistical_reporting.reason: Only one connected source group; a resampling confidence interval is not reported.
statistical_reporting.scope: Paired same-query differences are descriptive; leaders among 63 subsets and K sweeps are exploratory, not selected on a held-out validation collection.

model_settings.input_protocol: Both rerankers receive query text and fixed source page text, including two published empty page texts; page images are unavailable to text scoring.
model_settings.token_diagnostics_limit: Missing per-input token telemetry is not a measured zero-truncation result; the adapters reject reported truncation/overflow. The earlier Laya tokenizer audit covers only ColQwen/K=50.

laya_text.scope: Existing completed results; original-result usage is historical, not fresh inference by this audit or the latest resume.

bge_reranker_text.scope: Existing completed results; original-result usage is historical, not fresh inference by this audit or the latest resume.

metric_definitions.hit@5: Fraction of queries retrieving at least one positive page in the first five.
metric_definitions.recall@5: Mean fraction of all positive pages retrieved in the first five; multiple positives per query.
metric_definitions.ndcg@10: Graded normalized discounted cumulative gain, exponential gain 2^relevance - 1.

candidate_grid_caveat: Changing K changes the scored candidate set. Ranges span the 63 retrieval subsets, not uncertainty intervals; candidate budget modes must be compared separately.
